selection_guard: Reference and friend symbols are audit labels, never independent screening inputs
confidence_guard: Association, chart shape and keyword topics cannot establish fraud or calibrated dump probability
evidence_time_guard: Created and revised source timestamps must precede the decision; later findings may annotate causes only

mechanisms.guard: Voting control is not economic float; IPO firm association is not a dump clock
No archived public posts does not establish no campaign
Promotion is not itself a verified manipulation finding
Shelf capacity and registered resale shares do not prove sales
Distress does not establish fraud or a guaranteed decline
After-event reports cannot become advance features
Price morphology is not cause; warning recall is not executable entry accuracy

activation: Requires a new frozen experiment version and independent timing/portfolio validation
